text: Select: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, drug_indication.mesh_heading, drug_indication.mesh_id, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: drug_indication.mesh_id IN (SELECT level5 FROM atc_classification WHERE level1 = 'L' AND level2 LIKE 'C%') OR drug_indication.mesh_heading LIKE '%cancer%' OR drug_indication.mesh_heading LIKE '%neoplasm%'. Sort: None. Limit: None.
